verdict.rationale: Spline documents an official MCP server, bundled in the desktop app, that lets external agents such as Claude, Cursor and Codex "drive Spline" directly in the open editor tab. That is a write-capable agent surface, not a read-only one. The Code API only modifies object properties in exported runtimes, so it is not credited as design authoring, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: a documented list of MCP create/modify tools, independent hands-on corroboration, a write-capable REST/API surface beyond MCP, and availability outside the desktop app.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create or modify designs programmatically — through a write-capable API, plugin surface, or MCP tools — not just read them

citations.quote: Spline MCP Server — drive Spline from Claude, Cursor, Codex and other MCP clients, straight into your open editor tab.
The **Spline MCP Server** connects AI coding tools like **Claude**, **Cursor**, **Codex**, and **Antigravity** directly to your Spline editor.
The MCP server is bundled in the desktop app, so connecting Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Antigravity or ChatGPT to your editor only works here
